depends_on.name: time_reference_id
depends_on.documentation: Optional: when the session took place, normally an `absolute_time_reference` (its start in UTC, and its duration when known). The session is the referent of most relative times, so this places them in wall-clock time.

fields.name: local_identifier
fields.documentation: Human-facing handle for this session, unique within its dataset. Renamed from `reference` 2026-08-13 to match `subject` and `epoch`.

fields.name: description
fields.documentation: Optional: a free-text description of the session -- what was done, the lab notebook entry, and any notes about the day.

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: Optional: the session's display name, for people (e.g. 'Foraging concentration, experiment 1 (1 Feb 2022)'). `local_identifier` stays the stable handle code and paths use.
